chunks: And it has been narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:
"Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, chose from everything something, and He chose from the earth the place of the Ka'bah."

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: al-Ṣādiq, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House in Makkah

ai.seo_question: Why is the location of the Ka'bah considered specially chosen by Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, selected special things from among all created things. Among the earth, He chose the site of the Ka'bah, indicating its unique sanctity and distinction in relation to worship and hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2306 - It has been narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that he said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, chose something special from everything, and He chose from the earth the location of the Kaaba."
